howto.name: Upload 2+ videos
howto.text: MP4 / MOV / MKV / WebM / AVI, up to 20 clips; the whole upload has to fit within the 500 MB request limit.

howto.name: Reorder if needed
howto.text: Use the up and down arrows to set the order the clips play in. The first clip sets the frame size of the merged video.

howto.name: Download the merged video
howto.text: FFmpeg joins the clips in that order and re-encodes the result as one MP4 with H.264 video and AAC audio.

faq.q: Do the videos need the same resolution?
faq.a: No. The merged video takes the first clip's frame size as players show it, so a portrait phone clip first gives a portrait video. Every other clip is scaled to fit inside that frame without being stretched, and black bars fill any gap. Put the clip whose size you want first.
Silent audio is added (anullsrc) for missing tracks so concatenation succeeds.

faq.q: Can I add a transition between clips?
faq.a: No. Clips are joined directly, one after another; transitions such as crossfades are not supported.
